fact: Claude Code CLI uses NDJSON over WebSocket, Codex uses JSON-RPC
recommendation: Protocol-specific logic must be in ws-bridge.ts, not in routes

fact: Claude Code hooks receive JSON via stdin (INPUT=$(cat); parse with python3/jq) — the CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT environment variable is OBSOLETE (it was openclaw runtime / older Claude Code)
recommendation: In every hook: INPUT=$(cat); then python3 json.load(sys.stdin). PostToolUse payload includes tool_response with stdout/stderr/output/content; UserPromptSubmit has prompt; Stop has session_id+cwd. Settings.json is reloaded mid-session — hooks added live take effect immediately.

provenance.reference: 2026-05-10 adapting error-detector.sh from env-var API to stdin-JSON; live-confirmed Stop hook fired in same session it was added

fact: Anthropic API 400 when an image's declared media_type disagrees with its real bytes ('specified using image/png ... appears to be image/jpeg') poisons the WHOLE thread
recommendation: The bad image stays in history and replays on every turn, so each new message 400s again. Don't debug the latest message — find and remove/fix the mislabelled image in conversation history, then relaunch so the CLI re-reads it

fact: gonka-openai (TS) is a drop-in `class GonkaOpenAI extends OpenAI`: use `client.chat.completions.create` (native OpenAI streaming). Auth = per-request ECDSA signing via custom fetch (Authorization=signature, X-Timestamp, X-Requester-Address); apiKey is a throwaway 'mock-api-key'. Constructor does NOT auto-resolve GONKA_SOURCE_URL — call async resolveEndpoints()/GonkaOpenAI.create() first. Endpoints need {url,transferAddress}; GONKA_ENDPOINTS is 'url;transferAddress' comma pairs. Function tool_calls are returned but NEVER executed by the SDK.
recommendation: To add Gonka as an inference provider: build an adapter that owns a GonkaOpenAI client (no subprocess), gate reachability on resolveEndpoints before marking active, redact only GONKA_PRIVATE_KEY + Authorization/X-Timestamp (X-Requester-Address is public). A Gonka coding agent needs a server-side tool loop you build yourself.
